abort.single_instance_allowed: Home in Review is already set up.

user.title: Home in Review
user.description: A monthly report of your home, made from your energy dashboard, local weather and indoor sensors. Reports appear in the sidebar.

data_description.backfill_months: Earlier months are generated in the background from long-term statistics. Use 0 to skip.

settings.title: Home in Review options
settings.description: Open a section to change it. Saving closes this window.

data.notify_services: Notify when a report is ready

data_description.report_day: Last month's report is made on this day.
data_description.year_start_month: January for a calendar year; for example July for a heating season or the month your energy contract starts.

data.max_hourly_kwh: Largest plausible grid use per hour
data.heat_pump_heat_sensor: Heat delivered by the heat pump

data_description.fixed_costs_daily: Optional, including tax: standing charges and grid fees.
data_description.fixed_costs_monthly: Optional, including tax. Use a negative amount for a fixed tax credit.
data_description.max_hourly_kwh: Meter jumps above this per hour are treated as glitches. Roughly your connection: 3 × 25 A ≈ 17 kWh, 3 × 35 A ≈ 24 kWh, 1 × 40 A ≈ 9 kWh.
data_description.heat_pump_devices: Any brand: one or more energy sensors (the heat pump's own integration, a kWh meter or smart plug, e.g. compressor and backup heater). Adds a heat pump slide with electricity per degree day.
data_description.heat_pump_heat_sensor: Optional: energy sensors for heat delivered (many brands report heating and hot water separately; choose both). Adds the COP.

data_description.excluded_areas: Sensors in these areas are left out of the indoor climate. Empty = count everything.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Any temperature sensor with history; replaces the modelled temperature.
data_description.use_open_meteo: Free weather archive for your area (location rounded to ~10 km). Off: only your own sensor, without normals, rain or sunshine.

car.name: Car

data_description.teslamate_home_geofence: Used to count charging at home. Empty: a geofence called Home (or its translation).

car.description: Any car: choose its odometer sensor (from the car's own integration) and the energy sensor of your charger. With TeslaMate you get more (trips, charging at home and elsewhere, Wh/km): fill in its Grafana URL and the token of a Grafana service account with the Viewer role.

ai.name: AI summary

data_description.ai_instructions: Optional, e.g. the tone of voice or who lives in the house.

ai.description: Optional: a short written summary at the start of each report, by your own AI Task entity. Only the report's figures are sent.

tile_add.title: Add your own figure
tile_add.description: Shown on a 'Your figures' slide, compared with earlier months.

generate.name: Generate report
generate.description: Collects (or re-collects) the report for one month.

month.name: Month
month.description: As YYYY-MM. Defaults to last month.

backfill.name: Backfill reports
backfill.description: Generates reports for earlier months in the background.

months.name: Months
months.description: How many months to look back.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Also re-make months that already have a report (after an update or a change in options).
